companyName: Warner Bros. Discovery / New Line Cinema
companyContext: Warner Bros. Discovery is a leading global media and entertainment company. New Line Cinema is a subsidiary film production label within Warner Bros. Motion Picture Group, known for producing franchises like The Lord of the Rings, The Conjuring, and Final Destination. New Line Cinema is the production house behind the Mortal Kombat reboot film series.
brandContext: Mortal Kombat II is a 2026 American martial arts fantasy film directed by Simon McQuoid and written by Jeremy Slater. It is the sequel to Mortal Kombat (2021), the fourth installment in the Mortal Kombat film series based on the legendary video game franchise created by Ed Boon and John Tobias. The film follows Earthrealm's champions — now joined by Johnny Cage (Karl Urban) — as they compete in the ultimate, no-holds-barred, gory tournament to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn. The film is rated R, is 1 hour 56 minutes, and is distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures in theaters and IMAX.

typography.fontUses: Brand name and movie title lockup. The custom lettering designed originally by Midway Games, used across all Mortal Kombat franchise media including the film logo. Uppercase only.
In-universe text, headings, promotional taglines, and key marketing statements such as 'FINISH HIM' and tournament call-outs. All-caps gothic style.
Display headings, poster credits block header text, promotional banner headlines, and IMAX branding text. Condensed uppercase sans-serif at 40–64px for display, 24–32px for section headings.
Body text for marketing copy, website content, press materials, and digital communications. Set at 16px base, 1.5 line-height, with 500 weight for emphasis and subheadings (20px).
Subheadings, CTAs (Buy Tickets, Watch Trailer), navigation labels, and metadata (release date, rating, runtime). 14–20px size range.
Technical metadata, timestamps, promotional codes (e.g., Dragon Krystals offers), captions, and fine print. 12–14px monospaced.

brandVision: Mortal Kombat II aims to deliver a bigger, bloodier, and more faithful cinematic adaptation of the iconic video game tournament. Directed by Simon McQuoid with screenplay by Jeremy Slater, the film embraces the franchise's inherent weirdness, brutality, and mythology while centering the actual Mortal Kombat tournament — something fans demanded after the 2021 film. The brand vision is to establish a blockbuster trilogy (pre-tournament, during tournament, post-tournament) that rivals the best action-fantasy franchises in cinema, built on the strength of over 30 years of video game legacy.
brandValues: Brutal authenticity — Mortal Kombat does not shy away from its R-rated identity, delivering visceral fatalities and raw martial arts combat. Honor and sacrifice — Earthrealm's defenders unite across differences to face existential threats. Legacy and evolution — respecting the 1992 video game origins created by Ed Boon and John Tobias while evolving the narrative for modern cinema audiences. Fan-first storytelling — the sequel directly addresses fan feedback from the 2021 film, introducing beloved characters like Johnny Cage, Kitana, Jade, Baraka, and Shao Kahn. Inclusivity through diversity — the cast represents a global range of warriors and cultures. Competitive spirit — the brand embodies the thrill of one-on-one combat and the stakes of fighting for something greater than yourself.
